title: Design-system components have a consumer

facts.note: Design root plus first-level layer directory is a path fact; a repository with no design root never matches. Applies to every qualifying file regardless of extension and to existing exports as well as new or edited ones.

values: bun_design_system_detector: capitalized export with no consumer
facts.note: Whether an export has a consumer requires a repo-wide import-graph observer (bun_design_system_detector); it covers pre-existing orphans, edited exports, new exports, and exports whose last consumer was removed.

fires: A capitalized component is exported from a design-root `components` file and no other non-barrel file imports it.
A `primitives` export is only re-exported from an `index.*` barrel and nothing imports it from there.
An existing `templates` export that no other file imports is edited or encountered.
App code stops importing a `templates` export that no other file imports.
doesNotFire: The repository has no `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system` directory.
The export lives in a `tokens` or `foundations` layer.
The export is lowercase (a non-component helper or value).
The file is a test (`*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`), an `index.*` barrel, or in a vendored/build directory.
A template imports a component from the same design system (composition inside the system counts as a consumer).

given: A file whose first directory beneath a design root (a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`) is `primitives`, `components`, or `templates` exports a capitalized component.
when: Such an export exists, or the coder adds, changes, or stops consuming one.
then: Each such export MUST have a consumer: another non-barrel file (higher design layer or app code) whose import clause names it or default-imports it under that name; otherwise remove the export.
prefer: Export a component only when a real consumer uses it.
During GREEN: if the current acceptance needs it, wire that actual consumer to it.
During GREEN: if added speculatively with no required consumer, delete it.
During GREEN: keep only the smallest export surface the current behavior needs.
avoid: Exposing unrelated internals from a barrel to make the graph look connected.
Counting an `index.*` barrel re-export as consumption.
unless: The repository has no design root (self-scoping).
Test files (`*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`) and vendored/build directories are never scanned.
Token/foundation values and `index.*` barrels are not judged.
why: Unused components still have to be maintained, themed, and migrated; a design system grows by adjudication, not by accretion of pieces nobody uses.
evidence: The current behavioral or rendering acceptance passes.
Every affected export has a genuine consumer.
verifier_detail: Design root (term design_root): a directory named `design`, `design_system`, or `design-system`. A repository with no design root is not judged (self-scoping): there is no system to connect to yet.
The first directory beneath the design root names the layer: `tokens` or `foundations`, `primitives`, `components`, `templates`.
Consumer (term consumer): a non-barrel file whose import clause names the export, or imports it as a default under that name.
Detector (bun_design_system_detector) collects capitalized exports of primitives/components/templates and flags those no other file imports.
Consumers are counted the way `coder.vite.design-orphan-ui` does: composition inside the system (a template using a component) is legitimate consumption.
audit: Bun realization of core obligation `coder.design.orphan-export`, counting consumers like `coder.vite.design-orphan-ui`.

additions.text: fires/doesNotFire examples and the observability notes on the path_glob and finding facts.
additions.justification: Activation must be observable; the examples only restate source terms, statement and exceptions without narrowing scope (no file-extension or diff-event restriction).
